sourceReviews.review: saveGame/getFormatter/loadGame: UC writer, two header bytes consumed; BZ decompressor deleted; .ftgd binary, other extension SOAP, .ftgt noncompatibility warning. Native load mutates BGM before world completion; retain modern candidate isolation.

save/load: independent BGMContribution[1] and World streams; OnDeserialization rebuilds outlook listeners; setWorld invokes module hooks; otherObjects is durable. Preserve H/V/Z conversion and reciprocal entity identities.
BindToType ignores assemblyName and searches contribution assemblies. Replace with inert profile-qualified signatures.
Stable source core assembly version 2.1.1.12; older sample assemblies are separate profiles.
Signed long currentTime and minute constants; totalMinutes subtracts START_TIME. Encode absolute currentTime distinctly from elapsed totalMinutes.
Signed long duration, including source controller sentinels; freeze signed arithmetic before runtime migration.

registerRepeated returns wrapper delegate for cancellation; queue holds absolute due minute. RepeatedTimer serializes clock/handler/interval; tick invokes due callback before removeMin. endOfTurnHandlers is NonSerialized.
SortedList entries compare priority then signed int id subtraction. Persist insertion identity/idGen and removal semantics; modern order encoding does not authorize arithmetic widening.
Liquid assets, debt and transaction delta are long; no prototype cash scaling. History is reached via account genres/otherObjects.
Contribution resolver identity; lazy history keyed by contribution in otherObjects, reset on world change. No catalog mutable state fallback.

Expanded long totals plus 32 day/13 month arrays; Recorder.OnDeserializedMethod repairs null arrays. TransactionHistory.OnDeserializedMethod repairs yesterday/lastmonth/lastyear/dayAgo/monthAgo wrappers. Constructors alone do not specify absent historical fields.

Durable _forwarding, boughtThisTrain nullable Time used for age-based resale, independent car and train/controller state; OnDeserialization recreates next-state calculator. Source comment mentions OptionalField but live _forwarding declaration has no such attribute.

Four timer handles retain old and aligned-hour/day identities. clockHandlerHour migrates nonnull old handles, then clears them; speciallisteners lazily rebuilt if null. OnDeserialization rebuilds nonserialized stationChangeListeners; onStationChange is nonserialized. TransportLog uses double lastweekperday.
Persist returned repeated-timer cancellation handle and host/nodes links; remove unregisters handle. Roof and costs belong to ExAV content/geometry rules.

PassagewayPlatform and StairPlatform passagewayRailType carry OptionalField(VersionAdded=5), declared concrete initializer. Missing-field import needs explicit enum-zero/profile rule, not constructor execution.
Persist XYSize/ZSize in addition to population/location/stations; two-argument constructor delegates 1,1, but this is not proof of historical missing-field defaults.
Special population listener durable station relationships/size; separate from ordinary listeners.
New onNewWorld otherObjects root {2B4B87D9-1856-4558-BD07-8C5D5467D109}; low/medium/fast location lists persist; static singleton is rebound.
Static System.Random rnd is not world-saved; saved plans/timers do not establish stochastic continuation.
otherObjects root {51CD7E24-4296-4043-B58D-A654AB71F121} plus timed updates retained.
onNewWorld binds otherObjects {227E053A-6667-43fe-8CE1-26EB55CE6A56}; retain accounts/assets and callbacks.
Returned repeatHandler is durable cancellation identity, separate from h_unit callback; onDue unregisters wrapper.
onNewWorld binds otherObjects {227E053A-6667-43fe-8CE2-26EB55CE6A56} and calls Economy world-loaded/new hooks.

repeatHandlerMajorUpdateEvent/MinorUpdateEvent retain returned wrappers. Economy and RandomEx explicitly stored/restored through otherObjects key and key+rand; static does not imply unsaved when reachable by this graph.
Persist capacity, specialstationListener, PopulationImpl, games/team state and repeatHandler; no reconstruction from a generic building alone.
Mutable _populs/_enters/_baseP are instance state, not catalog-only.
